units: <cite ref="Keritot 6a:51">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>שרף הנוֹטֵף וכ׳</he> the gum which exudes from balm-shrubs.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:1">Y. Peah VII, beg. 20ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00549"><he>נְטוֹפָה</he> II</cite>.
Sabb. 30ᵇ, a. e. שפתותיו נוֹטְפוֹת וכ׳, v. מַר II; a. fr.—נוֹטְפִים, נוֹטְפִין dripping water, collected rain water.
Mikv. V, 5, v. זָחַל; a. fr.—Trnsf. (cmp. נָבַע) to speak, prophesy.
Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIII, end (ref. to Joel IV, 18) אין יִטְּפוּ אלא נבואה yiṭṭ’fu alludes to prophecy; v. הַטָּפָה.—2) (cmp. טְפֵי III) to be too long, protrude, hang over.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 43b:18">Bekh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>חוטמו נוטף</he> one whose nose overhangs his lips; <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 5:3">Tosef. ib. V, 3</cite>.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:13">Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שלא נטפו</he> ed. Ven., v. <cite ref="H00639"><he>חָטַף</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Taanit 19a:7">Taan. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>התחילו גשמים מְנַטְּפִין</he> the rain began to come down drop-wise. Ohol. III, 5 <he>מת שדמו מְנַטֵּף</he> a slain body whose blood flows in drops, opp. <cite ref="U02141"><he>שותת</he></cite>. Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ top <he>ועודה מְנַטֶּפֶת</he> and when it is still overflowing; a. fr.
Tosef. M. Kat. I, 1 בריכה שנִיטּוֹפָה משדה וכ׳ (Var. ed. Zuck. נִיטְּפָה, נִיטַּיְּפָה Nithpa. of טוּף) a pond formed by the overflow (of rain) from a field &c.

senses.gloss: to be inundated, to overflow. Y. l. c. שדה … שניטופה לתוך וכ׳ a field dependent on irrigation which discharged its overflow (from rain) into another field (and there formed a pond).

to cause to flow; to drop. Y. Gitt. II, 44ᵇ top וכתב לא (ה)מַטִּיף ‘and he shall write’ (Deut. XXIV, 1) but not form letters by dropping; Y. Sabb. XII, end, 13ᵈ. Y. Pes. V, 32ᶜ bot. ישפך לא יַטִּיף ‘it shall be poured out’ (Deut. XII, 27), but he must not let it fall in drops.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:9">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:9">XVI</cite>), 9 <he>צריך להַטִּיף וכ׳</he> he must cause a few drops of the blood of the covenant to flow; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 46">Gen. R. s. 46</cite>.
